items.raw_excerpt: For the first time since 2023, the state of Sinaloa will stage Independence Day celebrations in Culiacán, incuding the traditional Grito.
items.summary_en: For the first time since 2023, the state of Sinaloa will hold Independence Day celebrations in Culiacan. The events will include the traditional Grito ceremony.

items.title_en: Sinaloa capital to hold Independence Day events again after 2 years

items.raw_excerpt: For many parts of the country, instructions for the weekend include tying down trampolines and keeping campervans home in preparation for strong winds and rain.
items.region: South Island and lower North Island
items.summary_en: Strong winds and rain will hit the South Island and the lower North Island this weekend. People are told to tie down trampolines and leave campervans at home.

items.title_en: Strong Wind and Rain Are Coming to Southern New Zealand

items.raw_excerpt: Two days before Te Waihorotiu station reveals itself, the station is filled with only the sounds of howling wind and the footsteps of security patrols.
items.summary_en: Model train fans visited Te Waihorotiu station in Auckland before its official opening. They were impressed by the new City Rail Link. The quiet station opens to the public soon.
items.summary_ko: 모형 기차 팬들이 공식 개장 전에 오클랜드의 테 와이호로티우 역을 둘러봤다. 새 도시 철도 노선에 깊은 인상을 받았다. 조용한 이 역은 곧 일반인에게 문을 연다.
items.title_en: Model train fans get early look at new Auckland rail station

items.summary_en: A local news site shared a video about Mikro Papigo, a very small village in northern Greece. The village sits in the mountains of the Zagori area. It is known for its stone houses and its amazing natural beauty.

items.raw_excerpt: Da Redação – Os candidatos ao Governo de Pernambuco concentram suas agendas na Região Metropolitana do Recife nesta sexta-feira (21). Raquel Lyra participa de atividades em Olinda e Itapissuma, João Campos cumpre compromissos no Recife e em Abreu e Lima, enquanto Ivan Moraes combina gravações com eventos culturais e de campanha na capital. João Campos […]
items.summary_en: People who want to be governor of Pernambuco held campaign events near Recife on Friday. Raquel Lyra walked with supporters in Olinda and Itapissuma. Joao Campos went to events in Recife and Abreu e Lima, and Ivan Moraes joined cultural and campaign events in the city.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 페르남부쿠 주 지사 후보들이 금요일 헤시피 근교에서 선거운동을 벌였습니다. 라켈 리라는 올린다와 이타피수마에서 유세를 했고, 조앙 캄푸스는 헤시피와 아브레우이리마에서 행사를 가졌습니다. 이반 모라이스는 시내에서 문화 행사와 선거 운동에 참여했습니다.
items.title_original: Raquel faz caminhada em Olinda, João vai a lançamento em Abreu e Lima e Ivan cumpre agenda no Recife - Blog do Ricardo Antunes

items.raw_excerpt: Três das mais faladas e premiadas curtas-metragens portugueses dos tempos mais recentes vão ter exibição em cinema a partir de 14 de setembro, anunciou esta sexta-feira a distribuidora Midas Filmes. "Cidade Pequena", de Diogo Costa Amarante, vencedor (pela terceira vez para Portugal) do Urso de Ouro do Festival de Berlim, em fevereiro passado. "Farpões Baldios", […]
items.summary_en: Distributor Midas Filmes says three new Portuguese short films will open in cinemas from September 14. One of them, "Cidade Pequena" by Diogo Costa Amarante, won the Golden Bear at the Berlin festival in February. It was the third Golden Bear win for Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 배급사 미다스 필름스가 새로운 포르투갈 단편 영화 세 편을 9월 14일부터 극장에서 개봉한다고 발표했습니다. 이 가운데 디오고 코스타 아마란테 감독의 '시다지 페케나'는 지난 2월 베를린 영화제에서 황금곰상을 받았습니다. 이는 포르투갈 영화로는 세 번째 황금곰상 수상입니다.
items.title_en: Three new Portuguese short films come to cinemas in September
items.title_original: Três novas curtas portuguesas nas salas de cinema em setembro - RTP Cinemax
